gui.bobin_craft.npc.briefing.quartermast: Inspect your kit before deploying. Reliable weapons and proper armor keep you alive. Bring salvage back for exchange.
gui.bobin_craft.npc.briefing.cook: A full ration pack goes further than courage. Food restores strength between contacts. Carry reserve supplies for a long return.
gui.bobin_craft.npc.briefing.medic: Carry treatment before you need it. Healing restores health; regeneration helps you recover over time. Find cover before treating injuries.
gui.bobin_craft.npc.briefing.commander: Prepare your instruments, review the map and select a deployment. Find a marked extraction point to bring your supplies home.
dialogue.bobin_craft.sentry.greeting: Hold there. You're inside the safe perimeter. Keep your weapon down and tell me what you need.
dialogue.bobin_craft.sentry.status: The perimeter is holding. Beyond the wire, every tree can hide a hostile patrol. Stay alert and listen before you move.
dialogue.bobin_craft.sentry.rules: Use the tactical map to deploy. Walking out of the hub without authorization marks you as a deserter. If the warning starts, return inside within ten seconds. After that, the strike is lethal.
dialogue.bobin_craft.sentry.duty: We watch the approaches and keep the camp secure. The tower teams cover the distant ground; checkpoint sentries control the entrance. If you need equipment, speak to the quartermaster.
dialogue.bobin_craft.quartermaster.greet: Quartermaster, fourth section. Weapons, protection and salvage exchange. Check your loadout now; the field won't give you a second chance.
dialogue.bobin_craft.quartermaster.statu: The armory is open. Supply is finite: inspect the available issues beside each request. I also take useful scrap and materials in exchange for credit.
dialogue.bobin_craft.quartermaster.rules: Deploy through the tactical map. Don't wander past the perimeter on foot: desertion control gives ten seconds to return before the strike. Bring your surviving equipment back through extraction.
dialogue.bobin_craft.quartermaster.duty: Choose a rifle for the distance you expect, then cover your head and chest. A close-range weapon helps in buildings; a sniper rifle needs open sightlines. Keep enough supplies for the return.
dialogue.bobin_craft.cook.greeting: You're just in time. I've got field rations ready. Sit if you can, eat while it's quiet, and take something for the road.
dialogue.bobin_craft.cook.status: The kitchen is running. Bread, meat and potatoes are ready to issue. Bring wheat or coal if you want to help keep the camp supplied.
dialogue.bobin_craft.cook.rules: Eat before you deploy, and use the map to leave the camp. If you step outside without deploying and hear the deserter warning, get back inside immediately.
dialogue.bobin_craft.cook.duty: Take a full meal for the march and a reserve for extraction. Better rations help when the trip runs long. Don't wait until you're hungry and under fire.
dialogue.bobin_craft.medic.greeting: Field medical station. If you're heading out, take treatment with you. I'd rather issue supplies now than patch you up too late.
dialogue.bobin_craft.medic.status: The station is ready. Healing and regeneration supplies are available while stock lasts. Empty bottles can be exchanged here.
dialogue.bobin_craft.medic.rules: The safe perimeter is the place to prepare. Depart through the tactical map. A deserter strike is fatal; if you trigger that warning, return before its ten-second countdown ends.
dialogue.bobin_craft.medic.duty: Keep healing within reach. Break line of sight and reach cover before using treatment. Regeneration takes time, so leave yourself room to recover instead of pushing wounded.
dialogue.bobin_craft.commander.greeting: Operations is listening. Prepare your equipment, review the map and choose your deployment carefully. Your return matters as much as your objective.
dialogue.bobin_craft.commander.status: The camp remains secure. Outside, conditions change and hostile groups control their own ground. Read the tactical map and keep an extraction route in mind.
dialogue.bobin_craft.commander.rules: All departures use map deployment. Leaving the hub on foot triggers a ten-second deserter countdown. Return inside to cancel it; remaining outside calls a lethal airstrike.
dialogue.bobin_craft.commander.duty: Open the tactical map and select an offered deployment point. In the field, use your map to plan a route to a marked extraction. Extract to bring your equipment back to camp. I can issue navigation instruments here.
raid.bobin_craft.deserter_warning: Return to the hub! Unauthorized departure detected.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.deserter.warni: Deserter. Return to the perimeter. Ten seconds.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.sentry.greetin: Sentry: Halt. Friendly identified. What do you need?
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.sentry.reply: Sentry: Perimeter is secure. Use your tactical map before departure.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.sentry.accept: Sentry: Copy that. Stay inside the wire until you deploy.
Quartermaster: Quartermaster here. Weapons, armor, and field supplies.
Quartermaster: Check your kit. A clean rifle brings you home.
Quartermaster: Requisition approved. Put that equipment to good use.
Quartermaster: Good hunting. Bring your gear back.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.cook.greeting: Cook: Mess tent is open. Hot food for a long patrol.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.cook.reply: Cook: A full stomach keeps you on your feet out there.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.cook.accept: Cook: One field ration, ready to go.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.cook.goodbye: Cook: Come back in one piece. Supper is at sundown.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.medic.greeting: Medic: Field medic. Take a breath. How can I help?
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.medic.reply: Medic: Carry a dressing, and never ignore an injury.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.medic.accept: Medic: Medical supplies issued. Keep them within reach.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.medic.goodbye: Medic: Look after yourself. I will be here.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.commander.gree: Commander: Report in. We have work beyond the perimeter.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.commander.repl: Commander: Study the map, select your deployment, and stay focused.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.commander.acce: Commander: Orders confirmed. You are cleared to deploy by map.
subtitles.bobin_craft.hub.commander.good: Commander: Complete the objective. Return to this outpost.
